training.schedule: constant; outer refit exact inner-selected epochs

R2.selection: lowest inner EMA validation full-risk Efron loss; ties prefer smaller scale; separately for each model/outer-fold/seed
R2.normalization: parameter-free LayerNorm of cross-modal context before all adapters
R2.bounds: delta logit and B additive correction each bounded by chosen scale; not a bound on final risk

R2_trigger.population: first32 inner-training patients, label-blind row order; selected R1_A8_noDirect checkpoints

R3_gate.note: overlapping inner validation partitions: a descriptive engineering gate, not independent OOF inference

R3.comparison: forward versus reverse WSI order, retrained with identical parameters and compute; no bidirectional model unless separately registered
R3.selection: same fold-local training and epoch selection

bootstrap.sampling: shared patient counts within fixed outer folds; seeds averaged after each seed within-fold pair aggregation; fixed outer-train IPCW

config.scope: new exploratory repair on repeatedly developed cohort; no claim of external confirmation; no outer scores read before staged architecture decisions
config.privacy: only anonymous aggregate tables and code published; checkpoints, OOF, patient arrays private
config.controls: all noDirect models retain own RNA/CNA trainable pathway token late main effects; wrong context swaps only molecular state context in partition, never own late evidence
